checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same golden retriever recognisable in same pose
must.why: Same seated, front-facing golden with open mouth and tongue; tail on the right matches.

must.item: Contours and facial features clearer than source
must.why: Eyes, nose, ears and fur are much crisper.

must.item: Natural fur/edges, no halos or invented decorative detail
must.why: The fur is plausible, but the AI has invented detail: parked cars, a fence post, buildings, leaf litter and grass blades. It has a slightly over-processed AI look.

must.item: Background and full original framing preserved
must.why: The park setting is the same, but the framing is shifted: the dog is larger and the paws sit near the bottom edge. The background was redrawn with new content.

must.item: 640 px long edge, aspect ratio preserved
must.why: The image I viewed is about 512×512, not 640. The square aspect is kept.

faults.what: Output appears to be 512 px, not the claimed 640 px long edge (based on the image as viewed).
The AI regenerated the scene, adding details that weren't in the source (cars, fence, buildings, leaves). The framing and dog scale also shifted.
Face and fur are somewhat smoothed and look slightly AI-rendered; the muzzle and mouth details were reinterpreted.

summary: The dog is much sharper and clearly the same golden retriever, but the scene was regenerated with invented background details and the viewed file is about 512 px rather than the claimed 640 px.
